code.cut: It has more than {most} functions and types: only the first {most}
code.grammar: The grammar of {language} cannot be used: {e}
code.list.key: card_list of functions and types (kind: symbol) takes no {key} in value (it takes section, of, name, limit and after)
code.list.kindAlone: kind symbol is not listed with other kinds (functions and types are read from the files)
code.list.nameString: name is a string that is not empty ({other})
code.list.overLimit: There are more than {limit} files: only the first {limit} were read
code.loader.abi: The grammar's version (ABI {abi}) does not fit ({min} to {max} can be read)
code.loader.bundled: {id} is the id of a language built in (add a new grammar under a new id)
code.loader.id: The language's id "{id}" is written in lower-case letters, digits, _ and -
code.loader.libraryName: library "{library}" is written as the name of a file in the folder
code.loader.link: {path} is a link (put the grammar's files in the folder itself)
code.loader.missing: {path} is not there (or cannot be read)
code.loader.owner: {path} is not owned by the user the agent runs as
code.loader.writable: {path} is a file others can write, or its group can (fix it with chmod go-w)
code.noLanguage: The language {language} is not available on this machine (its files are shown without functions and types)
code.noParser: Nothing reads it ({language} is not available on this machine)
code.noSymbols: Functions and types are not read in {language} files
code.symbol.missingHere: There is no {symbol} in this file (nearest: {near})
code.symbol.noDirs: The working directories are not read
code.symbol.noLanguage: It is not a file of a language whose functions and types are read
code.symbol.noLines: "{path}" is a function or type inside a file. No line leaves one (a line to it is drawn from another card: an "Implemented by" line)
code.symbol.noPicture: "{path}" is a function or type inside a file and has no picture (read it with card_read)
code.symbol.readKey: card_read of a function or type takes no {key} in value (it takes lines, find and context)
code.symbol.readOnly: "{path}" is a function or type inside a file (made from the file, it cannot be written)
code.symbol.unread: Cannot read the functions and types of {file}: {why}
code.timedOut: Stopped: reading it took longer than {ms} ms
code.tooLarge: Too large to read for functions and types ({size} bytes; up to {most})
code.unreadable: Cannot read the file {path} (it is not there, or cannot be read)
